$comment: Single source of truth for the games on Little Wonders. The hub renders its cards from this, CI smoke-tests every entry, and tools/check.mjs validates it. status: live | soon | template. A 'soon' game shows a Coming soon card that is not clickable; 'template' entries are tested but never listed.
